buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Payment

PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 3. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of Sr.DFM payable at VADODARA . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C Sr.DFM VADODARA . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date 5. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of Sr.DFM payable at VADODARA . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 6. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of Sr.DFM VADODARA A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 7. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS & CONDITIONS (ATC)

A. Bidder Eligibility and Credentials 1. Eligibility under PQC: The bidder shall fulfil all financial, work-experience an d other eligibility criteria prescribed under the PQC. Non-fulfilment shall render the offer technically non-responsive and liable for rejection. 2. Legal Status and Identity: The bidder shall submit PAN, GST registration, co nstitution-related documents (as applicable), registered office proof and authori sation of the signatory. All submitted details shall be consistent and verifiable. 3. Work Experience and Financial Capacity: The bidder shall submit genuine work orders, completion/performance certificates and audited financial stateme nts/ITRs as prescribed under PQC. Relevant client details, work value and compl etion period shall be clearly indicated. Documents shall be verifiable, including t hrough UDIN wherever applicable. Non-fulfilment shall render the offer non-resp onsive and liable for rejection. Firm having previous work experience in RPF bar racks will be given preference for carrying out this work. 4. Declarations and Past Performance: The bidder shall declare that it is not d ebarred/blacklisted by any Government Department, Railway or PSU and disclos e any insolvency proceedings, contract termination, poor performance or manp ower-related default. False declarations, concealment, cartelisation or submissi on of multiple bids through proxy entities shall invite penalty and further action as per rules. B. Business Establishment and Pre-Bid 5. Gujarat Office: The bidder shall have a genuine operational business establishment in Gujarat and submit GST registration, Shops and Establishment s registration or any other Government-recognised address proof. Railway reser ves the right to physically verify the establishment. Non-fulfilment shall render t he offer technically non-responsive and will be rejected. 6. Mandatory Pre-Bid Meeting (Non-Negotiable): Since the contract covers a pproximately 10 RPF barracks, which is situated at nearly 9 different districts of Gujarat, at different locations across Vadodara Division, attendance at the pre-b id meeting is mandatory to understand the geographical spread, scope and site -specific requirements. The proprietor/partner/director or duly authorised repres entative shall attend with valid ID and authorisation. Attendance shall be record ed, and non-attendance shall render the bid technically non-responsive, and will be summarily rejected. 7. Site Inspection: The bidder shall inspect the locations as per Railway arrange

ments and familiarise itself with site conditions, manpower requirements and op erational constraints. No claim arising from lack of site knowledge shall ordinaril y be entertained. C. Labour and Manpower Compliance 8. Minimum Wages: Quoted rates shall comply with minimum wages notified by CLC, Ministry of Labour & Employment, or the applicable authority, prevailing o n the tender opening date, including subsequent revisions. Rates below the applicable minimum wages shall be rejected. 9. Statutory Compliance: The contractor shall maintain valid EPFO, ESIC and ot her applicable registrations/licences and ensure timely payment of wages, EPF/ EPS, ESIC, bonus and other statutory benefits. Monthly wage records, bank pay ment proofs, ECRs and challans shall be submitted to the Railway. 10. Police Verification and Identity: Only genuine, identified and suitably train ed personnel shall be deployed. Their identity details and police/character verifi cation, as required under prevailing Railway instructions, shall be submitted bef ore deployment. Any replacement shall be intimated to and approved by the Ra ilway. 11. Shramik Kalyan Portal: The contractor shall register the contract and deplo yed workers on the Shramik Kalyan Portal, wherever applicable, and regularly u pdate the required manpower, wage and statutory compliance details. 12. Wage Payment and Bank Account: The bidder shall maintain an active ba nk account in the name of the bidding entity. Wages shall be paid directly into workers' bank accounts within the prescribed statutory timelines. Cash paymen t shall not be accepted except where legally permitted. D. Contract Execution and Monitoring 13. Supervision and Service Continuity: The contractor shall provide adequat e supervision across all locations and nominate an authorised single point of co ntact. Absentees shall be replaced promptly to ensure uninterrupted services. 14. Attendance and Service Quality: Location-wise daily attendance and deplo yment records shall be maintained and verified by Railway officials. Payment sh all be restricted to actual verified services. False attendance or deficient service

shall attract recovery and other contractual action. 15. Inspection and Verification: Railway authorities shall have the right to insp ect work sites, verify credentials, manpower, attendance, wage payments and s tatutory records. The contractor shall produce original records and extend full c ooperation. 16. Document Submission and Authenticity: All mandatory documents prescr ibed under the tender/PQC/ATC shall be submitted within the stipulated time in legible and valid form. No bidder shall have an automatic right to submit missin g or material documents after bid closure. Clarifications may be sought only as permissible under procurement rules. Forged, misleading, illegible or concealed information shall invite rejection and appropriate action. 17. Subletting: The contractor shall not sublet or transfer the contract, wholly or partly, without prior written approval of the Railway. The contractor shall remai n fully responsible for all personnel and approved subcontracted activities. E. Financial and Contractual Conditions 18. GST: GST shall be applicable as per prevailing law and tender conditions. The contractor shall maintain valid GST registration and submit applicable tax invoic es and statutory compliance details. 19. Performance Security: Performance Security shall be furnished at 5% of the contract value, subject to applicable Railway Board instructions/GCC for Service s, in the prescribed form and within the stipulated time and subject to revision f rom time to time. 20. Monthly Bills and Supporting Documents: Monthly bills shall be supporte d by location-wise attendance, deployment details, wage payment proofs, EPF/E SIC ECRs and challans, and Shramik Kalyan Portal compliance wherever applica ble. Payment shall be made only for verified services, subject to statutory comp liance and recoveries. 21. Penalties, Safety and Indemnity: Deficiencies, absence of manpower, stat utory defaults or breach of contract shall attract penalties, recoveries, withholdi ng of payment, risk-and-cost action or termination as per contract. The contract or shall ensure personnel comply with Railway security, safety and discipline re quirements and shall indemnify the Railway to the extent permissible under law . 22. Termination: Persistent poor performance, abandonment of work, manpowe

r shortage, non-payment of wages, statutory non-compliance, fraud or material breach may result in termination in accordance with applicable contractual prov isions and due process. F. General Conditions 23. Contract Period and Variations: The contract shall commence as specified in the LOA/work order. Any variation in scope, quantity or deployment shall be made only through written orders and in accordance with applicable rules. 24. Force Majeure and Dispute Resolution: Force majeure, dispute resolution and other contractual matters shall be governed by the applicable GCC for Services, Railway Board instructions and prevailing laws. 25. Order of Precedence and Acceptance: In case of any inconsistency, the or der of precedence specified in the tender shall apply. Submission of the bid shal l imply acceptance of the tender conditions, PQC, ATC, applicable GCC for Servic es, special conditions and corrigenda. .
